enumeratedValue.name: RDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- Rising edge (since Reset or you wrote a 1 to this field last time), Write 1- Clear rising-edge detection for this pin

enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- No falling edge (since Reset or you wrote a 1 to this field last time), Write 0- No operation

enumeratedValue.name: FDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- Falling edge (since Reset or you wrote a 1 to this field last time), Write 1- Clear falling-edge detection for this bit

enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- Interrupt is not requested, Write 0- No operation

enumeratedValue.name: PSTAT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- Interrupt is requested, Write 1 (edge-sensitive)- clear rising- and falling-edge detection for this pin, Write 1 (level-sensitive)- switch the active level for this pin in

field.name: SEL_PMATCH
field.description: Specifies whether the pin interrupts are controlled by the pin interrupt function or by the pattern-match function. If this value is 0b, interrupts are driven in response to the standard pin interrupt function. If this value is 1b, interrupts are driven in response to pattern matches.

field.name: ENA_RXEV
field.description: Enables the RXEV output to the CPU and/or to a GPIO output, when the specified Boolean expression evaluates to true. If this value is 0b, RXEV output to the CPU is disabled. If this value is 1b, RXEV output to the CPU is enabled.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS0
field.description: Determines whether slice 0 is an endpoint. Slice 0 is not an endpoint. Slice 0 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 0 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS1
field.description: Determines whether slice 1 is an endpoint. Slice 1 is not an endpoint. Slice 1 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 1 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS2
field.description: Determines whether slice 2 is an endpoint. Slice 2 is not an endpoint. Slice 2 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 2 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS3
field.description: Determines whether slice 3 is an endpoint. Slice 3 is not an endpoint. Slice 3 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 3 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS4
field.description: Determines whether slice 4 is an endpoint. Slice 4 is not an endpoint. Slice 4 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 4 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS5
field.description: Determines whether slice 5 is an endpoint. Slice 5 is not an endpoint. Slice 5 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 5 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS6

enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBTM
enumeratedValue.description: AHB master in tier mode. Can read and write to memories at same or below level.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED

enumeratedValue.name: HALT

enumeratedValue.name: STALL
enumeratedValue.description: Stall the start of any new channels

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE

enumeratedValue.name: AVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Channel linking available and controlled by each channel's link settings

enumeratedValue.name: NO_START
enumeratedValue.description: Do not start the sequence. Writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Initiate the charger detection sequence. If the sequence is already running, writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Do not perform a software reset.

field.name: CLOCK_UNIT
field.description: Unit of Measurement Encoding for Clock Speed

field.name: CLOCK_SPEED
field.description: Numerical Value of Clock Speed in Binary

enumeratedValue.name: CONN_SDP
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to an SDP. Must comply with USB 2.0 by drawing only 2.5 mA (max) until connected.

enumeratedValue.name: CONN_CP
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to a charging port. The exact meaning depends on the STATUS[SEQ_STAT] field (value 0: Attached to either a CDP or a DCP. The charger type detection has not completed. value 1: Attached to a CDP. The charger type detection has completed.)

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DATA_PIN_CONN
enumeratedValue.description: The module is either not enabled, or the module is enabled but the data pins have not yet been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA_PIN_CONN
enumeratedValue.description: Data pin contact detection is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: The detection sequence is not running for over 1 s.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: It is over 1 s since the data pin contact was detected and debounced.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_OVERRIDE
enumeratedValue.description: No overrides. Field must remain at this value during normal USB data communication to prevent unexpected conditions on USB_DP and USB_DM pins. (Default)

enumeratedValue.name: PRI_DET_OVERRIDE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables VDP_SRC voltage source for the USB_DP pin and IDM_SINK current source for the USB_DM pin.

field.name: TDCD_DBNC
field.description: Time Period to Debounce D+ Signal

field.name: CHECK_DM
field.description: Time Before Check of D- Line

field.name: TVDPSRC_CON
field.description: Time Period Before Enabling D+ Pullup

enumeratedValue.name: state_logic_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: State, logic, and parallel modes supported

enumeratedValue.name: state_logic_parallel_pinctrl
enumeratedValue.description: State, logic, and parallel modes, plus pin control registers supported

enumeratedValue.name: receive
enumeratedValue.description: Receive mode; capture the current shifter content into SHIFTBUF on expiration of the timer

enumeratedValue.name: transmit
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit mode; load SHIFTBUF contents into the shifter on expiration of the timer

enumeratedValue.name: matchstore
enumeratedValue.description: Match Store mode; shifter data is compared to SHIFTBUF content on expiration of the timer

enumeratedValue.name: matchcont
enumeratedValue.description: Match Continuous mode; shifter data is continuously compared to SHIFTBUF contents

enumeratedValue.name: state
enumeratedValue.description: State mode; SHIFTBUF contents store programmable state attributes

enumeratedValue.name: logic
enumeratedValue.description: Logic mode; SHIFTBUF contents implement programmable logic lookup table

enumeratedValue.name: opend_bidirouten
enumeratedValue.description: Shifter pin open-drain or bidirectional output enable

enumeratedValue.name: value00
enumeratedValue.description: Start bit disabled for Transmitter, Receiver, and Match Store modes; Transmitter mode loads data on enable

enumeratedValue.name: value01
enumeratedValue.description: Start bit disabled for Transmitter, Receiver, and Match Store modes; Transmitter mode loads data on first shift

enumeratedValue.name: value10
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter mode outputs start bit value 0 before loading data on first shift; if start bit is not 0, Receiver and Match Store modes set error flag

enumeratedValue.name: value11
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter mode outputs start bit value 1 before loading data on first shift; if start bit is not 1, Receiver and Match Store modes set error flag

enumeratedValue.name: value00
enumeratedValue.description: Stop bit disabled for Transmitter, Receiver, and Match Store modes

enumeratedValue.name: value01
enumeratedValue.description: Stop bit disabled for Transmitter, Receiver, and Match Store modes; when timer is in stop condition, Receiver and Match Store modes store receive data on the configured shift edge

enumeratedValue.name: value10
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter mode outputs stop bit value 0 in Match Store mode; if stop bit is not 0, Receiver and Match Store modes set error flag (when timer is in stop condition, these modes also store receive data on the configured shift edge)

enumeratedValue.name: value11
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter mode outputs stop bit value 1 in Match Store mode; if stop bit is not 1, Receiver and Match Store modes set error flag (when timer is in stop condition, these modes also store receive data on the configured shift edge)

enumeratedValue.name: not_blocked
enumeratedValue.description: Generate the timer enable event as normal

enumeratedValue.name: blocked
enumeratedValue.description: Block the timer enable event unless the timer status flag is clear

enumeratedValue.name: pinsel
enumeratedValue.description: PINSEL selects timer pin input and output

enumeratedValue.name: pinselplus1
enumeratedValue.description: PINSEL + 1 selects the timer pin input; timer pin output remains selected by PINSEL

enumeratedValue.name: opend_bidirouten
enumeratedValue.description: Timer pin open-drain or bidirectional output enable

enumeratedValue.name: enable_tmr_cmp_dis
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled on timer compare and timer disable

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_nminus1_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on timer n-1 enable

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_trig_pin_hi_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on trigger high and pin high

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_pinrise_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on pin rising edge

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_pinrise_trighi_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on pin rising edge and trigger high

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_trigrise_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on trigger rising edge

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_trigedge_en
enumeratedValue.description: Timer enabled on trigger rising or falling edge

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_nminus1
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on timer n-1 disable

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_cmp
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on timer compare (upper 8 bits match and decrement)

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_cmp_triglow
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on timer compare (upper 8 bits match and decrement) and trigger low

enumeratedValue.name: pin_edge
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on pin rising or falling edge

enumeratedValue.name: pin_edge_trighi
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on pin rising or falling edge provided trigger is high

enumeratedValue.name: trig_falledge
enumeratedValue.description: Timer disabled on trigger falling edge

enumeratedValue.name: tmr_out_hi
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on timer output high.

enumeratedValue.name: pin_eq_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on timer pin equal to timer output

enumeratedValue.name: trig_eq_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on timer trigger equal to timer output

enumeratedValue.name: pin_rise_edge
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on timer pin rising edge

enumeratedValue.name: trig_rise_edge
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on trigger rising edge

enumeratedValue.name: trig_edge
enumeratedValue.description: Timer reset on trigger rising or falling edge

enumeratedValue.name: flexio_clk_shiftclk_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on FLEXIO clock; shift clock equals timer output

enumeratedValue.name: trig_edge_shiftclk_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on trigger input (both edges); shift clock equals timer output

enumeratedValue.name: pin_edge_shiftclk_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on pin input (both edges); shift clock equals pin input

enumeratedValue.name: trig_edge_shiftclk_trig_in
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on trigger input (both edges); shift clock equals trigger input

enumeratedValue.name: flexio_clk_div16_shiftclk_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on FLEXIO clock divided by 16; shift clock equals timer output

enumeratedValue.name: flexio_clk_div256_shiftclk_tmr_out
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on FLEXIO clock divided by 256; shift clock equals timer output

enumeratedValue.name: pin_rise_shiftclk_pin_in
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on pin input (rising edge); shift clock equals pin input

enumeratedValue.name: trig_rise_shiftclk_trig_in
enumeratedValue.description: Decrement counter on trigger input (rising edge); shift clock equals trigger input

enumeratedValue.name: one
enumeratedValue.description: Logic one when enabled; not affected by timer reset

enumeratedValue.name: zero
enumeratedValue.description: Logic zero when enabled; not affected by timer reset

enumeratedValue.name: one_tmrreset
enumeratedValue.description: Logic one when enabled and on timer reset

enumeratedValue.name: zero_tmrreset
enumeratedValue.description: Logic zero when enabled and on timer reset

field.name: INTID
field.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-479.

register.name: AIRCR
register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

field.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
field.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SYSRESETREQ
field.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: Do not request a system reset.

field.name: SYSRESETREQS
field.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

field.name: PRIGROUP
field.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

field.name: BFHFNMINS
field.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

enumeratedValue.name: NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

field.name: PRIS
field.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SAME_PRIORITY
enumeratedValue.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

field.name: ENDIANNESS
field.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: VECTKEY
field.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

register.name: SCR
register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

field.name: SLEEPONEXIT
field.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

field.name: SLEEPDEEP
field.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SLEEPDEEPS
field.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

field.name: SEVONPEND
field.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

enumeratedValue.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor

register.name: SHCSR

enumeratedValue.description: Debug monitor exception is not active.

register.name: TYPE
register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.

field.name: SEPARATE
field.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv8-M only supports a unified MPU

field.name: DREGION
field.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.

field.name: HFNMIENA
field.description: Enables the operation of MPU during HardFault and NMI handlers

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MPU is disabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The MPU is enabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged accesses.

field.name: REGION
field.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

field.name: SH
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: BASE
field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTRINDX
field.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

field.name: LIMIT
field.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

field.name: SH
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: BASE
field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTR0
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 0.

field.name: ATTR1
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 1.

field.name: ATTR2
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 2.

field.name: ATTR3
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 3.

field.name: ATTR4
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 4.

field.name: ATTR5
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 5.

field.name: ATTR6
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 6.

field.name: ATTR7
field.description: Memory attribute encoding for MPU regions with an AttrIndex of 7.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable. Enables the SAU. This bit is RAZ/WI when the Security Extension is implemented without an SAU region.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURED_MEMORY
enumeratedValue.description: Memory is marked as Secure and is not Non-secure callable.

field.name: SREGION
field.description: SAU regions. The number of implemented SAU regions.

register.name: RNR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Number Register

register.name: RBAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Base Address Register

field.name: BADDR
field.description: Base address. Holds bits[31:5] of the base address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the base address are defined as 0x00.

register.name: RLAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Limit Address Register

field.name: NSC
field.description: Non-secure callable. Controls whether Non-secure state is permitted to execute an SG instruction from this region.

field.name: LADDR
field.description: Limit address. Holds bits[31:5] of the limit address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the limit address are defined as 0x1F.

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: When the SFARVALID bit of the SFSR is set to 1, this field holds the address of an access that caused an SAU violation.
